lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And you’re sure that, are you sure about that?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK, then you said that you took her outta the, the of the back of the ah her vehicle. (Brendan nods “yes”) Did you help him do that?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And then you said that he went and got the a gun. Right?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And he came back in? (Brendan nods “yes”) What did he do?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Tell me where he shot her.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Like in the head and some in the belly and the stomach.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: How many times did he shoot her in the head?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Tell me where in the head. What sides?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Like the left side I think it was.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: The left side of her head (Brendan nods “yes”) and the when he shot her in the body, where in the body again?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK, what was he saying when he was doing this if anything? What was his demeanor? Was he calm, was he, what, what was he doing?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: What was he saying to you?
